prompt_text: Provide an exhaustive, highly detailed description of all visible objects, spatial relationships, materials, and lighting in this image.
caption:

In the background, a table is set for two, its surface covered with a black placemat. The table is positioned in front of a window, through which a blue sky can be seen. The window, framed by a white curtain, offers a glimpse of the world outside.
